baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَٱدْعُ, وَٱسْتَقِمْ كَمَا أُمِرْتَ, and وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The voiced call may incline hearers toward something, but the caller's own vector is fixed by received command and upright balance rather than by the audience's inclinations.

activation_trace.role: Calling by speech supplies an outward act that seeks to incline hearers.
Rectitude, balance, and evenness supply the caller's governing orientation.
Binding request fixes both steadfastness and justice as received obligations.
The soul's inclination supplies the rival directional force that must not steer the call.

changed_reading.before: Issue a call, remain personally upright, and resist their desires.
changed_reading.after: Conduct a public call whose direction remains answerable to received command, so responsiveness to hearers never becomes capture by their preferences.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لِأَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُم, the fourfold بَيْن, and لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Justice operates in a repeatedly marked middle: it counterbalances distinct sides, keeps a relation open across separation, and refuses to let the shared space become a contest for argumentative conquest.

activation_trace.role: A load balancing another load gives justice a concrete counterweight mechanism.
The middle between two sides supplies the field in which balancing must occur.
Prevailing proof supplies the competitive dominance explicitly removed from that middle.

changed_reading.before: Judge impartially and cease arguing with the other side.
changed_reading.after: Maintain a common relational middle by counterbalancing distinct parties while declining to turn that middle into a venue for argumentative domination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَنَا أَعْمَالُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَالُكُمْ, ٱللَّهُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا, and وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse first allocates deeds without collapsing their owners, then reserves the joining of separated parties and their final outcome to God. Human coexistence and divine adjudication occupy different stages.

activation_trace.role: Intentional action supplies the separately owned material of accountability.
Separation supplies the present plurality that gathering does not prematurely erase.
Joining dispersed parts assigns final reassembly to divine agency.
Becoming toward an outcome gives the gathering a terminal rather than immediate horizon.

changed_reading.before: Each side has its deeds, and everyone will ultimately return to God.
changed_reading.after: The verse establishes a two-stage order: deeds remain distinctly owned now, while only God later reassembles the parties at their common outcome.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ءَامَنتُ بِمَا أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن كِتَابٍ and ٱللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Trust receives whatever God has delivered as a binding written joining, while the doubled Lord relation places both parties under one sustaining and corrective source.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies trust rather than mere acknowledgment.
Delivery from above supplies the received direction of the books.
A written fixing that entails judgment supplies the books' binding force.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply a shared source without erasing distinct addressees.

changed_reading.before: Affirm all divinely revealed scripture and confess one Lord for both groups.
changed_reading.after: Accept every delivered book as a binding shared charge under the one source who sustains and corrects both parties.

context_deltas.mechanism: The whole-surah sequence turns the focus confession of every delivered book into an operating chain: divine disclosure reaches earlier recipients, a connected charge crosses prophetic generations, book is paired with the balance, and the same disclosure becomes light and a straight path.

activation_trace.role: Delivered revelation anchors the chain in the focus confession.
Binding inscription makes reception consequential rather than archival.
News or inspiration from God supplies continuity between the present recipient and those before.
A charge connected onward to another supplies intergenerational transmission.
The balance of justice makes the descended book a calibrating instrument.
Illumination makes revelation perceptive and directional.
A straight traversable road makes illumination a practiced course.

structural_cues: 42:3 opens by linking revelation to the present recipient and those before him.
42:17 immediately after the focus pairs the descended book with the balance.
42:52 closes the surah by calling the disclosure spirit and light and directing it toward a straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies continuity, transmitted charge, balance, light, and path; I supply the arrow that these are successive functions of the focus's faith in every book. A live alternative is that each image describes revelation independently rather than a single operating chain.

changed_reading.before: Trust every binding book delivered by the shared Lord.
changed_reading.after: Enter a transgenerational disclosure that binds, calibrates judgment, illuminates perception, and becomes a traversable straight course.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine gathering is repeatedly contrasted with present plurality: the gathering day contains distinct parties, God could have made one community but did not, dispersed creatures remain gatherable, and all affairs finally become toward Him. The focus's shared Lord therefore does not authorize forced social fusion.

activation_trace.role: Joining dispersed parties anchors the focus promise of divine reassembly.
Repeated separation preserves distinct parties within the promise of gathering.
A day that gathers people supplies the event horizon for the focus promise.
Distinct parties remain distinguishable inside the gathering scene.
Community supplies the collective unit God could have homogenized.
Making many into one is presented as possible divine action but not the present arrangement.
The ability to collect dispersed creatures expands gathering beyond one dispute.
All affairs becoming toward God confirms the terminal direction of gathering.

structural_cues: 42:7 places differentiated outcomes inside the day of gathering.
42:8 explicitly withholds the possible making of one community.
42:29 and 42:53 widen gathering from human parties to creatures and finally all affairs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a gathering day, differentiated parties, a counterfactual single community, and final convergence; I infer that the focus regulates plurality until divine judgment rather than commanding human homogenization. The live alternative is that 42:8 concerns only divine election, not social method.

changed_reading.before: Keep deeds separate for now because God will gather everyone later.
changed_reading.after: Protect accountable plurality under a shared Lord until a divine gathering that judges and reassembles without retroactively turning plurality into humanly enforced sameness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The call is framed by establishment without fragmentation, answered response, extraction of counsel through review, and an explicit limit: conveyance rather than custodial control. Upright invitation aims at an answering community, not possession of hearers.

activation_trace.role: The voiced invitation anchors the mechanism in the focus command.
Even alignment constrains the invitation's manner.
The same calling action is placed beside establishing religion.
Scattering into parts supplies the failure the call must not reproduce.
An answering return makes reception an active response rather than passive capture.
Extracting judgment by mutual review supplies a participatory social form.
Guardianship and custodial surveillance are explicitly denied as the messenger's task.
Delivering the message positively defines the task left after custody is denied.

structural_cues: 42:13 coordinates establishment, non-division, and calling in one movement.
42:38 places response, establishment, consultation, and shared spending together.
42:48 contrasts denied guardianship with sole responsibility for conveyance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call, non-fragmentation, response, consultation, and the conveyance-versus-guardianship contrast; I infer a non-coercive response loop as the call's social mechanism. A live alternative is that consultation describes only the already believing community and does not directly specify outreach.

changed_reading.before: Call people while keeping your own direction aligned.
changed_reading.after: Invite in a way that can elicit free response and participatory judgment, while refusing custodial ownership of those who turn away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prohibited inclinations are socially specified by two causal sequences: division follows knowledge through transgressive rivalry, and unbounded provision would produce transgression while measured descent restrains it. Desire is thus a limit-erasing force that converts knowledge or abundance into factional excess.

activation_trace.role: Inclination of the self anchors the rival force named in the focus.
Upright evenness supplies resistance to unchecked inclination.
Scattering into parts supplies the social result of rivalry after knowledge.
Crossing the limit through aggression supplies the drive behind learned division.
Unrestricted expansion supplies the abundance that can amplify transgression.
Repeated limit-crossing links material excess to the earlier factional excess.
Fitting a thing to a middle measure supplies the counter-mechanism to excess.

structural_cues: 42:14 explicitly places knowledge before division and names transgressive rivalry as its motive.
42:27 makes unrestricted provision a cause of transgression and measured descent its restraint.
The focus places non-following of inclinations between commanded rectitude and commanded justice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two explicit excess-to-disorder sequences; I identify their repeated limit crossing as a social and material specification of أهواء. A live alternative is that the focus means doctrinal preferences narrowly, while 42:27 concerns a separate economic psychology.

changed_reading.before: Do not let other people's preferences redirect the call.
changed_reading.after: Do not adopt the limit-erasing appetite that turns even knowledge or abundance into rivalry, fragmentation, and domination; answer it with measured rectitude.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah distinguishes argument pursued after a response, whose footing slips, from redress after transgressive wrong, which is permitted and proportioned, with reconciliation still open. The focus closes a contest over God without abolishing protection from injustice.

activation_trace.role: Prevailing proof anchors the competitive argument negated in the focus.
The repeated contest for prevailing proof identifies the kind of argument under judgment.
An answering response marks the point after which renewed contest becomes sterile.
A fallen, invalid argument supplies the failure mode of continued theological contest.
Aggressive limit crossing supplies a materially different trigger: suffered wrong.
The wronged party's obtaining redress supplies legitimate self-protection.
Matching an act with its consequence supplies a bounded response to harm.
Removing estrangement between people keeps reconciliation open beyond proportionate redress.

structural_cues: 42:16 immediately follows the focus and condemns argument after response.
42:39-42 explicitly permit redress after wrong and place blame on aggressors.
42:40 inserts pardon and reconciliation inside the proportional response rule.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a failed post-response God-dispute and a later permitted response to concrete wrong; I transfer that distinction into لَا حُجَّةَ. A live alternative is that the focus phrase is only a declaration about eschatological proof, not a norm for intercommunal procedure.

changed_reading.before: There is no argument between us, so conflict should simply stop.
changed_reading.after: End the dominance-seeking theological contest, but do not confuse that closure with surrender to aggression; bounded redress and reconciliation remain live.

context_deltas.mechanism: Justice develops from counterbalancing loads into a calibrated system: book arrives with the balance, provision descends by a fitting middle measure, and injury permits an equivalent response while pardon and repair may exceed strict equivalence. Justice is proportional but not mechanically maximal.

activation_trace.role: One load balancing another anchors justice as counterweight.
The balance of justice makes calibration part of revealed order.
Fitting something to a middle measure supplies context-sensitive proportion.
Act-for-act recompense supplies the rule of bounded response.
Likeness and equivalence set the response ceiling.
Leaving punishment and erasing fault supplies a permitted surplus beyond equivalence.
Removing interpersonal estrangement gives surplus mercy a reparative aim.

structural_cues: 42:17 pairs book and balance directly after the focus command to do justice.
42:27 contrasts dangerous expansion with measured descent.
42:40 states equivalence, then immediately opens pardon and repair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies balance, fitting measure, equivalent recompense, pardon, and repair; I infer a single calibration mechanism for the focus's justice. A live alternative is that provision measure is providential rather than juridical and only analogically informs human justice.

changed_reading.after: Calibrate claims and responses to their proper measure, cap retaliation at equivalence, and leave room for pardon when it actually repairs the relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The separately assigned deeds become cultivated yield, acquired consequence, an act that clothes its doer, and what hands have sent forward. Yet repeated pardon interrupts a closed economy of automatic return. Separate ledgers mark agency, not indifference or moral relativism.

activation_trace.role: Intentional work anchors the two parties' separately owned agency.
Work and acquisition as cultivation make deeds temporally productive.
Acquiring a gain attaches the resulting consequence to the actor.
An acquired act clothing its doer makes deed ownership intimate rather than merely recorded.
Acquisition is named as a source of affliction, making agency causally consequential.
What the two hands earn gives embodied ownership to the consequence.
Foregoing punishment and erasing fault prevents the deed-consequence relation from becoming mechanically closed.

structural_cues: 42:20 repeats cultivation for two differently directed futures.
42:22-23 place acquired deeds beside their enlarged outcomes.
42:30 and 42:34 repeat earned consequence followed by abundant pardon.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cultivation, acquisition, embodied hands, consequence, and pardon; I infer that these unpack the focus's allocation of أعمال. A live alternative is that لنا أعمالنا is chiefly a formula of disengagement and does not itself imply the packet's causal economy.

changed_reading.before: Each side is responsible for its own intentional deeds.
changed_reading.after: Each side cultivates and carries a deed-history whose effects remain its own, while divine pardon keeps responsibility from becoming an inescapable mechanical ledger.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The milk-starter image is materially remote from ordinary الدعوة, but it is an explicit branch of the focus root and the later response, rain, and revived growth give it a coherent catalytic mechanism. Render only as a generative analogy for the call, never as a lexical replacement for فَٱدْعُ.

activation_trace.role: Milk retained in the udder to draw what follows supplies a small initiating remainder that activates later flow.
An answering return supplies the later human flow elicited rather than forced by the call.
Life-giving rain supplies delayed release after hope has been cut off.
Rain reviving dried herbage supplies the regenerative result of the released flow.

changed_reading.before: The call is a complete proclamation delivered outward.
changed_reading.after: The call may be a deliberately sufficient starter that draws an answering and regenerative flow whose completion is not controlled by the caller.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Reading حُجَّة through an enclosing edge and activating it beside حِجَاب is spatial and cross-root, so it must not be presented as etymological derivation. It remains anchored in the focus noun, its repeated relational middle, and the later communication-through-a-barrier scene; qualify it as a spatial model of polemical closure.

activation_trace.role: A surrounding edge supplies argument as an enclosure erected around a party.
The middle between sides locates where the enclosure would obstruct relation.
A screening barrier supplies a later contrast in which distance does not make communication impossible.
Hiddenly imparted knowledge crosses modes of distance and keeps relation possible without direct exposure.

changed_reading.before: No argumentative claim remains between the two parties.
changed_reading.after: Do not build a polemical rim that seals the intercommunal middle; real difference and even veiling need not terminate communication.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The intact but sightless eye is a rare, branch-distant image under the focus root, not a proposed lexical sense of ٱسْتَقِمْ. Light, guidance, and straight path make it a packet-anchored warning against externally correct but unseeing form; downstream prose should mark it explicitly as a diagnostic analogy.

activation_trace.role: An eye whose globe remains standing while sight is gone supplies externally intact but perceptively failed form.
Actual rectitude and evenness supply the positive alignment that mere intact appearance cannot guarantee.
Illumination supplies the perception absent from empty upright form.
Gentle direction toward the road turns perception into guided movement.
The straight road gives genuine rectitude a traversable direction.

changed_reading.after: Do not mistake intact religious posture for rectitude; the standing form must also see by revelation's light and move along its directed path.

strongest_changes: Faith in every descended book became a transgenerational sequence of binding, calibration, illumination, and guided movement.
Divine gathering came to preserve accountable plurality until final outcome rather than license humanly enforced sameness.
The call became a non-custodial response loop ordered against fragmentation and completed through consultation and conveyance.
No argument was differentiated from legitimate redress, while justice became proportionate calibration open to reparative pardon.
Separate deeds became cultivated and embodied agency with real consequences but not a mechanically closed ledger.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly converted the focus's compact intercommunal formula into mechanisms: directional calling, measured restraint, responsive consultation, bounded redress, owned consequences, and a final gathering reserved to God. Several materially distant branches also remained coherent when contained as analogies rather than lexical claims.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether لَا حُجَّةَ primarily closes a rhetorical contest, states an eschatological fact, or also sets a procedural norm.
How directly the counterfactual single community in 42:8 governs human pluralism rather than only describing divine choice.
Whether provision by measure in 42:27 is a true model for human justice or only a useful material analogy.
The three outliers depend on branch-distance and should remain exploratory rather than enter unqualified synthesis.
